national.refreshOwner: Stage70 replaces this source and these dates with each accepted refit
national.otherSplit: Other stays one national bucket for MMP; inside each seat it is split by that seat's own 2023 notional mix of the non-core parties (Stage73, James 2026-10-07)

candidate.status: Stage75: the Stage33 S+R design refitted on every completed election (2011-2023 targets); 2026 features recentred on its training-only means

baseline.status: Stage69 voting-place notionals (D103), adopted 2026-10-07; previous source data/processed/forecast-transport/party-construction.json (Stage41/64 population-flat)

release.status: Release policy approved by James, 2026-10-07 (D114): no calibration label; no staleness windows (every output states its refresh date); precision gate MCSE <= 0.01; one release after each accepted weekly poll refresh
release.reconciliationNote: Internal build gate only: the 64 general seats' party-vote means, weighted by valid party votes, must match the national mean within this many points. It is never shown to users
release.cadence: one release after each accepted weekly poll refresh
release.asOfLabel: Site copy says "Forecast if the election were held today, as of <dataCutoff date>" (the date of the poll refresh behind it); the estimand stays the D106 nowcast in specs, docs and field names (James, 2026-10-07)
release.afterElection: From election day (2026-11-07) outputs are frozen and labelled as of the last release; no further refreshes

simulation.precisionPolicy: Stage63 (PR #91, D095): layer Monte Carlo error is controlled by the layer replication count M per national draw (M = 16 met all six frozen Stage54 composed caps; M = 4 suffices for seat-win probabilities alone). National-driven quantities carry the finite national-bank floor that replication cannot lower and are reported with effective-sample-size Monte Carlo errors (batch means within national MCMC chains), never sqrt(p(1-p)/n). 4,096 national draws as in the Stage63 evaluation; rows = 4,096 x 16.

mmp.rulesNote: Electoral Act 1993 version 238.0 as at 1 January 2026 (D084, docs/mmp-rules-verification.md): 5% or one electorate, Sainte-Lague over 120, s 192 overhang added on top. No later amendment found affecting 2026 seat allocation (checked 2026-10-07)

hungParliament.definition: Hung: neither NAT+ACT+NZF nor LAB+GRN+TPM holds a majority of that draw's Parliament. TOP kingmaker: hung, and TOP's seats give either side a majority. Only NAT+ACT+NZF with TOP / only LAB+GRN+TPM with TOP: hung, and TOP's seats give that side but not the other a majority. Hung with neither side reaching a majority even with TOP is the remainder of hung and is not reported separately (James, 2026-10-07).

maori.decidedBy: James, 2026-10-07 (D114): Maori seats are shown as a labelled range; the four unpolled seats use a labelled fallback from the Maori layer without a poll. Stage78 / D115: the fallback is arm F (the 2023 result carried forward, no polled-seat swing), chosen by James on 2026-10-09; registered here by Stage80 / D118
